notes.content:

  -Nunchuck - "Be water, my friend."

notes.title: August 6th, 2024 Patch Note
notes.content: -Fixed a bug where reward interactions are disabled

notes.title: Major update note August 5th, 2024
notes.content:
-Added controller support

-UI
	-Completely reworked code logic
	-Added dialogue system to random encounters, Merchant now has the "shop" and "enhance" options separated for clarity
	-Added indicators for random encounters, reward drops, etc.
	-Added "Controls" option in the title screen/Esc menu, removed the ground visual elements in map 1
	-New loading screen
	-Updated most visual graphics

-Game mode changes
	-Changed from 20 minutes map selection session to run based, similar to a regular roguelike
	-Level 1, 2, 3 now has a game time of 7 minutes until the boss spawns
	-Level 4 consists of 3 separate maps of 3 minute sessions
	-Chest reward changed from 3 pick 1 to random drop(weapon, relic, salt coin, salt gem) upon opening
	-Added Shrines to random encounters, mostly base stat rewards for now, will expand upon
	-Moved Merchant to random encounters, he no longer disappears on a timer, added potion and coffee to shop options
	-Complete rebalance of most stats in the game, including character and monster(normal, elite and bosses) base stats, monster behavior, all passives, relics, weapons, tag set effects, etc.

-Visuals
	-Reworked background elements for the title screen
	-Adjusted map layouts, added destructible environmental objects
	-Added monster remains
	-Adjusted hit effect visuals
	-Added subtle screen shakes to various actions
	-Added sound and visuals for all character movement/dashes
	-Adjusted exp node visuals and added sounds upon pickup
	-Color adjustments, the game should now feel brighter and more saturated

-Other additions
	-Mage tower map(level 4)
	-20 new normal monsters
	-3 new red elite/mini boss monsters
	-1 new boss monster
	-23 new general passives
	-19 new special passives associated with Shrine encounters
	-9 new relics
	-unlockable weapons from the previous version of the game has been added to the common drop table.

notes.title: April 18th, 2024 Patch note
notes.content:
Fixed a visual bug where enemy projectiles are flattend

Updates might slow down while we are working on new contents as they take longer than one day to implement, thank you for understanding

notes.title: April 17th, 2024 Patch note
notes.content:
Changed visuals for [FIRE] tag effect, and it now has a maximum limit of 20 active at once
Fixed an issue where physics calculation are not paused when pausing the game (when an UI is active), which would cause significant stutter to the whole game's visuals
Fixed an issue where echoed attacks would not appear but still deals damage
Fixed an issue where UI would become stuck when player character level up/interact with an anvil
Fixed an issue where some monsters would stop moving when near player, their health reduced by around 30%
[SPLIT] tag removed from Rice Paddle's possible enhance rolls
Adjusted visuals for [LIGHTNING] tag effect (slightly thinner)
Increased meteor spread on Magon's meteor passive
Fixed a bug where the game wont end when a boss dies before the second boss spawns

notes.title: April 15th, 2024 Patch note
notes.content:

notes.title: April 14th, 2024 Patch note
notes.content:
-Thunder Strike internal cd changed to 0.2(previously 1)second
-Re-built exp drop system, exp nodes no longer merge, larger nodes will drop as game time progresses, this should be a significant performance increase
-While this will momentarily be the last major performance patch as we shift gear into adding more content to the game, please keep us posted on any feedbacks at all, especially performance related and we will try our best to address them ASAP, thank you.
